name: log-in-with-ethos
title: Log in with Ethos
description: A minimal React example for developers showing how to add "Log in with Ethos" through Privy cross-app login and fetch the user's Ethos profile.

services.name: privy
services.purpose: Cross-app login with the Ethos Network Privy app
services.notes: Needs only the public app id (VITE_PRIVY_APP_ID), baked in at build time; the app's domain must be allowed in the Privy dashboard.

services.name: ethos-api
services.purpose: Profile by Ethos Everywhere wallet address

notes: Static Vite build served by Deno Deploy (project ethos, runtime static from ./dist). VITE_PRIVY_APP_ID is a public build-time value, not a secret. Linked from the developer docs as the reference integration.
